text:
You need someone who can proofread pharmaceutical marketing materials carefully, catch the obvious typos and the less obvious issues, and do it quickly in Adobe PDFs.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience working with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. While my background is technical, the same habits that make me effective in ML work—precision, consistency, and careful review of details—translate well to proofreading work where accuracy and completeness matter.

One project I’d point to is Product recommendations for Tidewater Outfitters in e-commerce. I built similar items and you-may-also-like carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis using Python, PyTorch, implicit, Redis, and AWS SageMaker. That work led to a click-through rate increase of 14% in a 4-week A/B test. The reason I mention it is because it required the kind of close attention to structure, edge cases, and consistency that’s useful when reviewing revised copy and checking that nothing was missed.

For your pharmaceutical and device marketing materials, I can help with sense checks, grammar and syntax review, fact-checking against marked changes, and a careful second pass for anything else that looks off. I understand that these pieces may need a fast 24-hour turnaround when they’re short, and I’m comfortable working methodically through a document to make sure revisions are clean and consistent. I can also work with Adobe PDFs.

If a piece requires a deeper read of prescribing information, references, or longer-form content, I’ll take the time needed to review it thoroughly rather than rush through it. My approach is organized, detail-oriented, and focused on making sure the final version is ready for review with confidence.

Would you like me to focus on just the changed sections first, or do you want a full-document proofread including any issues I notice beyond the marked edits?
